knownWeakSpots: A first name that is in no database table, not in the built-in gazetteer and written in lower case is replaced only after a preposition cue (with/for/to/from/about) and when it is not one edit from a dictionary word.
Narrative content with no name in it (health, family, pets, travel plans, long voice transcripts) is kept as written: it is not name-based personal data and the engine needs it.
Absolute dates and clock times are real: only names, places, contacts and ids are pseudonymised.
Two of twelve users write most of the rows (u07, u09): report per-user results, not only pooled ones.
Pseudonyms are drawn from a small public pool; an inflected pseudonym can read slightly oddly (Cyrillic ending on a Latin or place pseudonym).

leakGates.note: entity forms and stems, whole-string and regex gates run on every string of every record

mapping: private: kept at 0600 on the build host, never exported

labels.method: two independent model annotators per chunk following LABELING.md (round 1: preliminary 366-row cut, 341 labels carried over by identical text/date/clock; round 2: 211 rows), schema-validated, disagreements adjudicated by a stated rule, any unclear mark makes the label unclear

split.stratifiedBy: user x family; decided once from the labels, never reshuffled
split.note: Two users (u07, u09) write about 83% of the rows; per-user results are reported; rule-eligible rows are about 23% of rows (dev 85, held-out 42), so intervals on the held-out are wide.
